How we work

Predictable delivery, visible progress, maintainable code.

A delivery process designed so you always know what is done, what is next, and what is at risk, whether we are building a product, modernizing a system, or extending your team.

Discuss Your Project

Delivery process

Five phases, each with a clear outcome.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand business needs and technical requirements.

    • Stakeholder and user conversations
    • Review of current workflows, systems, and data
    • Constraints, risks, and success criteria

    OutcomeShared scope, priorities, and success criteria

  2. 02

    Architect

    Design a scalable, practical solution.

    • Architecture options with trade-offs explained
    • Technology choices that fit your team and environment
    • Delivery plan, milestones, and risk register

    OutcomeArchitecture and milestone plan

  3. 03

    Build

    Deliver through clear engineering milestones.

    • Short iterations with working software demonstrated
    • Code review on every change
    • Automated tests and continuous integration

    OutcomeWorking software at each milestone

  4. 04

    Validate

    Test quality, reliability, and performance.

    • Automated, exploratory, and acceptance testing
    • Performance and security checks
    • Evaluation sets for AI components

    OutcomeRelease readiness review

  5. 05

    Launch and Improve

    Deploy and support ongoing improvements.

    • Staged rollout with monitoring
    • Documentation and handoff
    • Prioritized improvement backlog

    OutcomeProduction release and next-step roadmap

Communication

A steady rhythm of updates and decisions.

Cadence is agreed at kickoff to fit your team. These are the defaults we start from.

  1. Kickoff

    Goals, roles, working hours, tools, communication channels, and escalation paths agreed in writing.

  2. Every iteration

    Planning, a demo of working software, and a short written update covering progress, decisions, and risks.

  3. Every milestone

    A review against acceptance criteria, an updated plan, and any changes to scope discussed openly.

  4. Always

    A shared backlog and repository, so progress is visible without waiting for a meeting.

Quality assurance

Quality built into everyday engineering.

Testing and review are part of how we build, not a phase at the end.

  • Code review on every change

    No change reaches the main branch without review by another engineer.

  • Automated testing

    Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests appropriate to the risk of each component, run in CI.

  • Continuous integration

    Every change is built and tested automatically, with staging environments for acceptance.

  • Performance and reliability checks

    Load, latency, and failure-mode testing for the paths that matter most.

  • Security practices

    Least-privilege access, secrets management, dependency scanning, and security-focused review.

  • AI evaluation

    Evaluation sets, regression checks, and monitoring for every AI component before and after launch.
